output.answer: Capital One Financial Corporation (NYSE: COF) is a McLean, Virginia-based financial services holding company founded in 1988 and led since its 1994 IPO by founder, Chairman and CEO Richard D. Fairbank. It operates through three segments — Credit Card, Consumer Banking and Commercial Banking — serving more than 100 million customers in the US, Canada and the UK, and it was the largest US credit card issuer by outstanding balances as of December 31, 2025. Its May 18, 2025 acquisition of Discover Financial Services added the Discover, PULSE and Diners Club payment networks, and it closed the ~$4.5 billion acquisition of fintech Brex on April 7, 2026. As of September 30, 2026 it held $676.2 billion in total assets and $480.7 billion in deposits, and reported Q3 2026 net income of $3.5 billion ($5.61 diluted EPS) on $16.3 billion of total net revenue. The company had approximately 76,300 employees as of December 31, 2025 and trades on the NYSE under "COF".
caveats: Q3 2026 figures are from the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 (filed November 3, 2026); Capital One's own Q3 2026 earnings press release could not be fetched, so headline numbers rest on the 10-Q.
Employee count (~76,300) is as of December 31, 2025 from the 2025 Form 10-K and may have changed since; stockanalysis.com lists 77,500 as of November 2026.
The 'more than 100 million customers' figure is company-stated on Capital One's About page without a precise as-of date.
Capital One has completed major acquisitions (Discover, May 2025; Brex, April 2026) whose integration is ongoing, so segment, brand and workforce details may continue to change.

passages.quote: On April 7, 2026, the Company completed its previously announced acquisition of Brex Inc., a Delaware corporation (“Brex” and such acquisition, the “Brex acquisition”), pursuant to the terms of an Agreement and Plan of Merger and Reorganization, dated as of January 22, 2026 with Brex and certain other parties thereto. Brex offers businesses solutions to issue corporate cards, automate expense management and make secure, real-time payments. The Brex acquisition enhances the Company’s offerings in the business payments marketplace. The total consideration paid to Brex shareholders for the acquisition was approximately $4.5 billion and included $2.6 billion of cash consideration and 10.6 million shares of common stock, par value $0.01 per share, of the Company with a fair value of $1.9 billion. Immediately following the completion of the Brex acquisition, the Company paid off Brex’s outstanding debt of $1.1 billion.

passages.quote: We were the largest issuer of credit cards in the United States of America (“U.S.”) based on the outstanding balance of credit card loans as of December 31, 2025. In addition to credit cards, we also offer debit cards, bank lending, treasury management and depository services, auto loans and other consumer lending products in markets across the U.S. As one of the nation’s largest banks based on deposits as of December 31, 2025, we service banking customer accounts through digital channels and our network of branch locations, cafés, call centers and automated teller machines (“ATMs”). Additionally, through the acquisition of Discover, we acquired new products including personal loans as well as the Discover Network, the PULSE Network, Diners Club International (“Diners Club”) and Network Partners (collectively, the “Global Payment Network”).

Our human capital practices are designed to develop a collaborative work environment while rewarding employees based on the merit of their work. We prioritize employee recruitment, development, recognition and retention. Capital One Financial Corporation (NYSE: COF) today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Discover Financial Services.

Capital One Financial Corporation (www.capitalone.com) is a financial holding company which, along with its subsidiaries, had $367.5 billion in deposits and $493.6 billion in total assets as of March 31, 2025. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, Capital One offers a broad spectrum of financial products and services to consumers, small businesses and commercial clients through a variety of channels. Capital One, N.A. has branches and Cafés located primarily in New York, Louisiana, Texas, Maryland, Virginia and the District of Columbia. A Fortune 500 company, Capital One trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “COF” and is included in the S&P 100 index.

More than 25 years ago, Capital One revolutionized the credit card industry with data and technology. Today, we are one of the most widely recognized brands in banking — serving more than 100 million customers across a diverse set of businesses.
Capital One Financial Corporation was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in McLean, Virginia.

The company is founder-led: Richard D. Fairbank is founder, Chairman, CEO and President, having been CEO since the company's November 1994 IPO and Chairman and CEO since February 1995.
Capital One operates through three segments: Credit Card, Consumer Banking, and Commercial Banking, and serves consumers, small businesses and commercial clients in the US, Canada and the UK.
